text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win...! I want to beat Logo!! I 
want to win, I want to win—I don't want to 
lose!!)

text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text:
(—Then I shall win!! I shall win right 
now!! I'll win, I can win! —I MUST 
WIN!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Woooooooaaaahhhhhhh-! Aaaaaaaalllllll 
rrrrrrrrriiiiiiiggggggghhhhhhht!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...?!" "Is that voice... Epi?!" 
"Th-This is completely out of control!!" 
—"Can she hold out until the very end...?"
choice_data_list: Hang in there, Epi...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, crap...!" "Should I go now?!" 
"...Ngh, no, I can't let her throw off my 
pace—"
choice_data_list: 頑張れ、エピ……！！

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
…………――Don't rush. Run your own race... at 
your own pace――!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A complete victory for Logotype!! Once 
again showing the run of a champion!! The 
Junior Class champion has conquered the 
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Alright!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Logo...! Congratulations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You ran with such confidence, it was 
amazing...! To me, you looked brighter 
than anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Only Logo... stayed true to his 
own race. Such incredible grit in an 
atmosphere like that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of girl Logo-chan is... 
Heh. Apparently her family runs a sign 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Sign makers? They're still around today! 
I'll look into it a bit more when I get 
back~."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is the right way after all. 
I'll stick to this path—all the way to the 
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Damn it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Logo!!! I knew you 
were strong...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, I was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Their cheers gave me a huge push, and I 
hope it left a lasting impression on 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You know... Logo-chan seems pretty cool." 
"I think I'll root for her in the Derby 
too♪" "...Huh, she's the daughter of a 
signboard shop owner?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I lost!
choice_data_list: You did great, good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but— If you don't feel that 
spark of destiny, then it's no good.
choice_data_list: よく頑張ったよ、お疲れ様
choice_data_list_en: You worked so hard. Great job today.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone felt like the logo was destiny! I 
really have to produce results...!
choice_data_list: ...Is that really all there is to it?
...Is that really all there is to it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that supposed to mean!?
choice_data_list: ……それだけじゃないんじゃないか？
……それだけじゃないんじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: ...Don't you think there's more to it than that?
...Isn't there more to it than that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Getting results isn't the only way to 
captivate hearts. Logotype's run today 
gave it everything she had—it was truly 
magnificent."
choice_data_list:
It seems your perfect run left an 
impression on everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!? In that case...
choice_data_list: 完璧な走りが、みんなの胸に残ったみたい
choice_data_list_en: It looks like your flawless run left a lasting impression on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No! Just the way you are is fine!!
choice_data_list: 何か変える必要があるのかも
choice_data_list_en: Maybe we need to change something.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too! It says 
keep going, go as far as we can!"
choice_data_list: (Well, that makes sense—)
(Well, I guess that's true—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I understand what you're saying, 
too!
choice_data_list: （まあ、そうだよな――）
（まあ、そうだよね――）

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The reality is, Logo got what I wanted. If 
I stay the way I am now, it's just not 
going to cut it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then... what do you think you need to 
change?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The kind of interest Epiphaneia seeks is 
so intense that people "feel destiny" in 
her. Merely being liked isn't enough; 
what's needed is—
choice_data_list: You have to stay disciplined when you run.

Make sure you stay disciplined when you 
run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, she can't hold back her 
overflowing fighting spirit and is running 
purely on instinct, but... if she comes to 
terms with her feelings and claims a 
flawless victory at the Nippon Derby――"
choice_data_list: 自分を律して走るんだ
自分を律して走るんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Make sure you stay disciplined when you run.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: 運命を感じる子も、きっと増える
choice_data_list_en: I'm sure more girls will feel that spark of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's usually one for quick decisions, yet 
now she's deep in thought... Honestly, I 
expected her to answer, "Even so, I'll run 
however I please," but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll follow your lead!
choice_data_list:
Are you sure? Even if it's a different 
path from the voice of destiny...?

Are you sure? Even if it's a different 
path from the voice of destiny...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's the right thing to 
do! But still—!
choice_data_list: いいのか？運命の声とは違う道だけど……
いいの？運命の声とは違う道だけど……
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure? Even though it's a different path from the voice of destiny...?
Are you sure? Even though it's a different path from the voice of destiny...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely want to win the Derby!! I 
don't want a repeat of what happened 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I will never allow such a thing! I'll 
win, and make everyone feel destiny at 
work!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Up until today, I ran while being pushed 
forward by everyone's voices. So this 
time—I'm believing in you!
choice_data_list: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having her follow our instructions instead 
of the voice of destiny. I already know 
full well just how unprecedented that is 
for her.
choice_data_list: ……ありがとう

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her primary goal all along, the Japanese 
Derby... Her greatest rival isâherself.
choice_data_list: 君の信頼に、応える
貴方の信頼に、応える
choice_data_list_en: I will live up to your trust.
I will live up to your trust.
